Citrix._comment: Bangalore site, one counter, one dish per slot (themes Mon-Thu = mix, Fri = biryani). The client stated the non-veg schedule for Mon, Tue, Wed and Fri and said nothing about THURSDAY, so Thursday's non-veg dish is left to the solver — except that `citrix_biryani_only_on_biryani_day` stops it taking the week's one chicken biryani, which would then be unavailable on Friday where the client asked for it. `buttermilk_twice_weekly` is disabled because it says the opposite of what this client asked: the city rule puts buttermilk on EXACTLY two non-consecutive welcome-drink days, and Citrix's welcome drink is buttermilk every day — the two together are unsatisfiable and the counter came back INFEASIBLE with the pre-flight reporting a clean bill of health, since neither rule is wrong on its own.

rules._comment: 'Welcome drink will be buttermilk only.' A one-slot composition component IS 'this slot must be a matching dish' (CLAUDE.md note 20). Bangalore carries 10 buttermilks, which is fewer than the ~20 distinct dishes a daily slot needs inside the 20-day cooldown window — hence the staple declaration below, without which the slot has nothing legal from week three.
rules.name: citrix_welcome_drink_is_buttermilk

rules._comment: 10 distinct buttermilks cannot fill a daily slot across a 20-day no-repeat window, so the history ban has to stand down — but `scope: cooldown` keeps `unique_items`, so the week still serves five different buttermilks and a repeat only comes once every distinct one has been used (CLAUDE.md note 11's treatment, per client). Under the default `both` scope the solver was free to pour the same tempered buttermilk on Monday and Thursday while eight others went unused.
rules.name: citrix_buttermilk_may_recur_across_weeks

rules._comment: 'If veg gravy is north then veg dry should be north.' SOFT: the client's own instruction was 'if I give south I can use north fallback', so a day whose veg dry can only be South pulls the gravy South rather than failing.
rules.name: citrix_veg_gravy_and_veg_dry_same_region

rules._comment: 'Flavour rice and veg gravy should be of the same region.' Same mechanism, same reason. On a Chinese or continental day neither slot carries a listed value, so the rule says nothing and the theme rules own the day.
rules.name: citrix_rice_and_veg_gravy_same_region

rules._comment: 'Nonveg main: Mon & Wed Chicken gravy, Tue - Egg curry, Friday Biryani.' One cell a day, so a `count: 1` component leaves it no choice — which is what 'only' means. Mon/Wed exclude is_egg_dish because a handful of egg dishes carry a chicken-gravy flag in the ontology (the same correction Tekion's config makes).
rules.name: citrix_nonveg_by_weekday

rules._comment: 'Nonveg main: Mon & Wed chicken gravy, Tue egg curry, Friday biryani' names four days out of five, and the client confirmed the fifth is deliberate: THURSDAY IS BLANK. The station stands down rather than serving an unscheduled dish, which also settles what would otherwise be the loosest cell on the counter.
rules.name: citrix_nonveg_mon_tue_wed_fri

rules._comment: Friday is this counter's biryani day and the client asked for the biryani there. A `mix` day is not narrowed by the theme filter at all, so without this the solver could spend the week's one chicken biryani on a Monday or Wednesday and leave Friday's mandate unsatisfiable (CLAUDE.md note 9e, the `allowed_day_types` case). Weekly, not per-horizon: the rule's own sentence says 'the week's one chicken biryani', and Friday is forced by the composition, so a 14-day plan forces two and a horizon-wide `max: 1` made the pair unsatisfiable.
rules.name: citrix_biryani_only_on_biryani_day

rules._comment: 'The region should alternate from south and north, should not be the same on 2 continuous days for flavour rice, veg gravy and veg dry.' Six rules — one per (slot, region) — because `avoid_consecutive` penalises ONE selector repeating on adjacent days, and a base_slot list would instead read a north rice on Monday beside a north gravy on Tuesday as the repeat. Written out rather than shelved: the rule library is for bodies a SECOND client needs.
rules.name: citrix_rice_north_not_two_days_running
